import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_points = scanner.nextInt();
        int multiplier = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] sequence = new int[total_points];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; i++) {
            sequence[i] = (multiplier * i) % total_points;
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points - 1, MODULUS));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visitedNodes = new boolean[total_points];
        int[] cycleSizes = new int[total_points + 1]; // size index up to total_points
        long answer = 1;

        for (int node = 0; node < total_points; node++) {
            if (visitedNodes[node]) {
                continue;
            }
            int count = 0;
            int currentNode = node;
            while (!visitedNodes[currentNode]) {
                visitedNodes[currentNode] = true;
                currentNode = sequence[currentNode];
                count++;
            }
            cycleSizes[count]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total_points; size++) {
            int c = cycleSizes[size];
            if (c != 0) {
                long total = size * c + (size > 1 ? 1 : 0);
                answer = (answer * powMod(total, c, MODULUS)) % MODULUS;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
